packages.label: פִּדְיוֹן וְהַמְתָּקַת הַדִּין
packages.label_en: Redemption and the Sweetening of Judgment
packages.reason: פִּדְיוֹן (redemption) and הַמְתָּקָה (sweetening) are not two sequential steps — they are two names for the same spiritual act. The Torah uses them interchangeably throughout: 'לַעֲשׂוֹת פִּדְיוֹן לְהַמְתִּיק הַדִּין', 'עַל-יְדֵי פִּדְיוֹן וְהַהַמְתָּקָה'. Neither produces the other; each IS the other from a different angle. The cholam vowel (חוֹלָם) is drawn into this package because the Torah states explicitly 'חוֹלָם הוּא בְּחִינַת הַמְתָּקָה' — the vowel IS sweetening, not a symbol of it or a cause of it. The three Havayot (שָׁלֹשׁ הֲוָיוֹת) are part of this same cluster because the gematria of cholam equals three Havayot, establishing that cholam and the three Havayot share the same essential nature (they are the kabbalistic mechanism by which the sweetening operates). The word וְרַפֹּא with cholam also belongs here: 'וְרַפֹּא בְּחוֹלָם... בְּחִינַת הַמְתָּקָה'. All of these — פדיון, המתקה, חולם, שלש הויות, ורפא-בחולם — are different facets of the same reality: the act of nullifying and sweetening the harsh decree.

merge_notes.reason: The Torah explicitly says 'וְרַפֹּא בְּחוֹלָם, בְּחִינַת הַמְתָּקָה'. The word with the cholam vowel IS the aspect of sweetening. 'ורפא-בחולם' and 'חולם' are two formulations of the same node — the cholam vowel as the medium of sweetening. Merged into Package 1.

packages.label: רְפוּאָה וּרְשׁוּת הָרוֹפֵא
packages.reason: רְפוּאָה (healing/medicine), יְרַפֵּא-בְּצֵירֵי (the word with tzeirei vowel), and רְשׁוּת לְרוֹפֵא (the permission granted to the physician) all share the same essential nature: they are expressions of the domain of actual healing that becomes possible AFTER the sweetening. The Torah states 'יְרַפֵּא בְּצֵירֵי, בְּחִינַת... רְפוּאוֹת' — the tzeirei form of the word IS the aspect of medicine/healing. The physician's permission ('רְשׁוּת לְרוֹפֵא לְרַפְּאוֹת') is not merely a consequence of the sweetening — it IS the state of open healing space, the domain in which the illness no longer has a fixed decree governing it. All three are different expressions of the same reality: the opened, unlocked space of healing.

packages.label: מִדַּת הַדִּין וּמֹחִין דְּקַטְנוּת
packages.label_en: The Attribute of Strict Judgment and Constricted Consciousness
packages.reason: מִדַּת הַדִּין (the attribute of strict judgment), גְּזֵרָה (the decree), and מֹחִין דְּקַטְנוּת (constricted consciousness) all share the same essential nature: they are expressions of the domain of divine constriction and harsh judgment. The Torah states 'מֹחִין דְּקַטְנוּת שֶׁיּוֹרְדִין בַּגָּרוֹן' — the three Elokim names at the throat ARE the mochin d'katnut. Mochin d'katnut is not the cause of the harsh decree; it IS the inner nature of the constricted state that gives rise to harsh judgment. The גְּזֵרָה (divine decree that illness continues until a specific day, medicine, and physician converge) IS middat hadin in action. The three Elokim names (שְׁלֹשָׁה אֱלֹקִים שֶׁבַּגָּרוֹן) are the kabbalistic embodiment of this constricted domain, seated in the throat, needing sweetening via the three Havayot. This package is the evil mirror of Package 1 (פדיון/המתקה): Package 1 sweetens and dissolves Package 3.

merge_notes.reason: The Torah states explicitly that the three Elokim names in the throat ARE the mochin d'katnut ('שְׁלֹשָׁה אֱלֹקִים שֶׁבַּגָּרוֹן, שֶׁהֵם מֹחִין דְּקַטְנוּת'). These two nodes share the same essential nature — one is the functional state (constricted consciousness), the other is the kabbalistic name-configuration that embodies it. They are merged into Package 3.

good_evil_mirror.note: The Torah has a clean two-domain mirror structure. Package 1 (פדיון/המתקה — the positive act) is the direct antithesis and cure of Package 3 (מדת הדין/גזרה/מחין דקטנות — the constraining force). Package 2 (רפואה/healing) is the outcome domain that opens up after the sweetening. The structural flow is: Package 3 (evil) constrains → Package 1 (good act) sweetens Package 3 → Package 2 (good outcome) becomes possible.
